tool-management.impact.title: Current run impact
tool-management.impact.complete: Observed {{count}} in active runs in this project.
tool-management.impact.empty: No references observed in active runs in this project.
tool-management.impact.partial_count: Observed {{count}}; the remaining scope is not fully checked.
tool-management.impact.unknown_count: Observed {{count}}; the remaining source is unverified.
tool-management.impact.uncertain: The scope is not fully checked; the current impact count is uncertain.
tool-management.impact.unknown: The impact scope has not been verified.
tool-management.impact.scope: Only active runs in the current project and their nonterminal nodes are checked against the exact tool profile and configuration digest.
tool-management.impact.reason.run_limit: The active run limit was reached. Remaining runs are unchecked; the observed count is only a lower bound.
tool-management.impact.reason.node_limit: The node limit was reached. Remaining nodes are unchecked; the observed count is only a lower bound.
tool-management.impact.reason.source_una: Some sources could not be verified. The remaining impact is unknown; the observed count is not a total.
tool-management.impact.truncated: Showing {{shown}} observed references; more observed references are not listed.
tool-management.impact.unknown_detail: No verifiable impact observation is available. Read the original tool diagnostics again.
tool-management.impact.boundary: This excludes drafts, plans that have not started and historical unknown external processes. Disabling or removing an integration does not prove that an existing process stopped.
